environment.description: Kubernetes pod running the CI/CD plugin as a sidecar in the build namespace. The service is exposed via ClusterIP service on port 3000, accessible from any pod in the same namespace. No input validation middleware. Credentials are long-lived API tokens (rotation disabled in this cluster due to legacy compatibility flag `DISABLE_ROTATION=true` in the pod spec). The pipeline tokens grant push access to the container registry and read access to the secrets vault.
